transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello, doctor. For the past three weeks, I've been feeling this incredible, overwhelming surge of energy and my mood has been unusually high. I barely feel the need to sleep at all lately, but I still feel completely refreshed and ready to go.
During this high-energy period, have you had any unusual experiences, like hearing voices others can't hear, or holding strong beliefs that others find hard to believe?

Yes, ever since this high-energy phase started three weeks ago, I've been hearing whispering voices when no one is around. I've also felt this strong conviction that I have special, unique powers, though I worry that people are monitoring me because of it. None of these things ever happened to me before this mood change.
Have you ever experienced these voices or beliefs during times when your mood was completely normal, without feeling unusually energetic or depressed?

No, not at all. I only ever hear those voices and have those beliefs during these high-energy, active periods. When my mood is normal and stable, none of that happens and everything is completely quiet.
